eval_prompt_contract: Each eval: {id, prompt, style, assertions}. assertions assert the six-axes values + the tonal gate (can you name which ink / which angle-or-layer / where paper shows).

evals.prompt: 用半调海报做一张关于凌晨便利店的竖版海报，文案是 still open。

assertions.tonal_gate: can name the ink, the angle, and where paper shows

evals.prompt: 把「孤独」做成一张单墨高反差剪影海报，无字。

assertions.tonal_gate: 2-3 flat values, hard silhouette, no fine screen

evals.prompt: 做一张 16:9 的摄影展海报，红色摄影主体 + 黑色正文。

assertions.tonal_gate: photo screened, type solid, white paper, calm grid

evals.prompt: 做一张 3:5 的独立刊物封面，极疏空纸，绿色主墨。

assertions.tonal_gate: substantial empty paper, small subject, quiet type-off

evals.prompt: 做一张字图一体的展览海报，深蓝+安全橙叠印。

assertions.tonal_gate: type+photo share one stack, chosen crossing angles

evals.prompt: 做一张植物档案内页，绿墨主体 + 黑墨图注。

assertions.tonal_gate: archival plate, one image plate, multi-column captions

evals.prompt: 用不完美印刷拼贴做一张竖版海报：城市夜归，深夜两点的街，标题「凌晨两点的街」。

theme_roles: jump: small highlight ≤5% not in subject structure
assertions.tonal_gate: name the spot layer, the torn edge, and where paper shows

evals.prompt: 用点阵解构海报做一张竖版艺术海报，主题是「季风的边界」，主标题「季风」。

theme_roles: primary: subject dot matrix + CN headline
accent: subtitle, one object or one overprint crossing
assertions.tonal_gate: can name the two plates, their angles, the overprint accent and where paper shows; type solid not screened, dots dissipate, punctuation comma and period only

evals.prompt: 用中式剪纸做一张竖幅海报，主题「鱼跃龙门」，群像是鲤鱼群。

theme_roles: accent: one jump-color member, ≤1/10 of the group, at edge or corner
assertions.tonal_gate: can name the cut layer, the negative-space cutouts, the one jump member and where paper shows; no screening, no drop shadows

evals.prompt: 用点阵剪纸做一张竖幅海报，主题「山外有山」，群像是层叠山峦，用色倾向主色底色跳色三色。

theme_roles: primary: paper-cut group silhouettes built from coarse round dots 70-90%, highlights knock out to paper
accent: at most one muted jump-color member, ≤1/10 of the group, at edge or corner
assertions.tonal_gate: can name the main plate at 45 degrees, the jump plate offset ≥30 degrees, and where paper shows; interiors are dots never flat fill, no 100% solids, one 1mm misregistration as natural press error

evals.prompt: 用蓝染做一张竖版艺术海报，主题是「守夜人」，主标题「守夜」，副标题「灯亮着的地方就是岸」。

theme_roles: primary: subject indigo flat-value silhouette + CN headline
accent: subline, one local object or one overprint crossing; deepest indigo from overprint, not a third ink
assertions.tonal_gate: can name the pure white #FFFFFF plane, the two indigo/cobalt plates, the overprint deepest indigo, and where the white shows; dye tonal depth is flat values never halftone dots, dye speckle and hatch live only inside blue shapes, no aging, no floating lines, only headline+subline text

evals.prompt: 用经典致敬做一张概念海报，风格来源是包豪斯年代美学，主题是「秩序」。

theme_roles: primary: monumental bold headline + tiny subject structure
accent: one echo block / one graphic / one overprint crossing, tuned to the visual source
assertions.tonal_gate: can name the monumental headline vs tiny subject scale contrast, the large upper emptiness, the duotone overprint deepening on uncoated paper, the fine AM halftone with slight fade and one misregistration; source translated as motif not reproduced; Chinese line carries meaning, English echo smaller, no extra text, no QR/watermark/logo/mockup
